comments:
eed3ae0b:  ;;
 ;Main entry point for the installation
 ;;
 ;Initializes XPDABORT to empty string
 ;Performs Environment check
 ;Displays successful Environment check message
 ;Exits from installation process
1a31b8f3: Clears XPDABORT to allow install to proceed

32c48eaa: Checks if
 - User context is valid (DUZ)
 - User has programmer access (DUZ(0)='@')
 - System date is defined (DT)
 - Node delimiter is set (U='^')

If any condition fails, branches to ABRT
89d39fb1: Displays header message for aborting install
c78c7503: Displays reason for aborting install
8340ba10: Displays message indicating installation is aborted
b9ccb90a: Displays message indicating Environment check passed
1ce6974d: Returns to calling routine after successful environment check
39b31e2b: Sets XPDABORT=2 to indicate Environment check failure
166f1d2f: Sets variables for DIK call to delete entry 10.04 from PACKAGE FILE #393
9802bf67: Performs deletion of entry using ^DIK
abff6835: Returns to calling routine after Pre-Install
7ec34810: Initializes variables for DIC call
1aa33882: Sets DIC variables for OPTION file #19
f4c11c51: Sets X to new option name 'DGJ LOCAL VENDOR ADD'

af44f466: Attempts to add new option in file #19
If successful, performs additional steps
Else, returns
d7137055: Displays header message
3214408b: Displays message indicating option is being marked 'Out of Order'
53a08ba3: Sets text to mark option as disabled with specified message
e8834ab6: Marks the new option as 'Out of Order' using XPDMENU with specified text
8af8f1b8: Returns to calling routine after Post-Install
